blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Real-time... at infinite scale' Common Operating Picture claims never address what happens when forward nodes lose connectivity to the data fabric.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Same failure mode as the canonical 30fps crowd-detection case: a 'swiftly act in real-time' promise built for cloud-connected enterprise data streams has no described degraded mode for a DDIL tactical edge.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Platform originated from video-game engine and enterprise digital-twin use cases (logistics, telecom, data centers) where continuous connectivity is a safe assumption; the defense narrative was layered on afterward.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Worldscape leverages AI-driven decision-making to weave all your data together to visualize, model, simulate, and swiftly act in real-time, at infinite scale.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Offers 'Government & Defense Pricing' while the product itself is still 'currently in private preview' with no ATO/RMF/IL4-5 language anywhere.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A program office can't put a private-preview SaaS product loaded with 'kill chain' automation language onto a government network without an accreditation story — none exists yet in public materials.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The company is selling the defense use case ahead of building the compliance infrastructure to actually deliver it — common at this pre-GA, accelerator stage.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: For Government & Defense Pricing: Contact Us ... We are currently in private preview.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Every visible open role is a game-engine or full-stack software hire; none address field integration, ISSO/compliance, or DoD program delivery, despite pursuing a Space Force Delta 7 ISR accelerator slot.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Building 'kill chain' automation and Common Operating Picture tooling for Space Force requires someone who owns the accreditation and integration path onto government systems — the current hiring plan is entirely building the simulation engine, not fielding it.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team composition reflects the company's origin building game-engine-based simulation technology; the DoD go-to-market motion is newer than the core engineering org.
